prompt: Use case: identity-preserve narrative restaging. First inputs canonical identity portraits; next room master is only architectural/palette reference; LAST input is prior scene for cast, approved face morphology and exact task content, NOT a pose to preserve. Preserve each canonical face, adult age, hair, eye/nose/jaw proportions and characteristic accessories. Farah lens anatomical LEFT eye; Demir comms anatomical RIGHT ear; Nazari and Mirza have no eyewear. Balanced stylized adult head/body scale, neither oversized heads nor realistic tiny heads. Clean cel-shaded adventure-comic linework, natural supported anatomy, two arms per character. Restage as a candid working discussion across the lab bench. Farah sits at a low sloping evaluation console, three-quarter body angled into the work, with her stylus hovering over a calm input. Demir leans beside her, one hand on the bench and the other finger following the suspect input, brow pinched in reconsideration. Farah turns a small serious glance toward him as he asks a question; no one faces the camera. Four distinct connected arms, natural torso/neck alignments, no held-up cards or paper. Camera sees the work from a diagonal side angle, with the interface naturally oriented toward the crew. The single console shows a small supplied input pair titled Separate synthetic evaluation, subtitle One of 5 held-out pairs. Two exact eight-value rows: Calm [0.608,0.608,0.608,0.608,0.392,0.392,0.392,0.392] and Suspect [0.858,0.358,0.858,0.358,0.642,0.142,0.642,0.142]. No measured MSE is invented. One short task note below reads Inspect misses and false alarms. Keep figures and collaborative action dominant, compact table rather than a giant poster. All typography and table rules follow the console perspective. Other screens off, lab pillar dark muted sage, warm skin, aged brass, no fluorescent rim. Output one full 1536x1024 scene. No text outside genuine work artifacts, no captions, no hero portraits, no camera-facing eye contact or lesson cards.
